id.description: ID of person, workspace or virtual line.

type.description:
Type of the person, workspace or virtual line.
 * `PEOPLE` - Indicates that this object is a user.
 * `PLACE` - Indicates that this object is a place.
 * `VIRTUAL_LINE` - Indicates that this object is a virtual line.

firstName.description: First name of person, workspace or virtual line.

lastName.description: First name of person, workspace or virtual line.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number of person, workspace or virtual line.

extension.description: Extension of person, workspace or virtual line.

weight.description: Weight of person, workspace or virtual line. Only applied when call policy is `WEIGHTED`.

skillLevel.description: Skill level of person, workspace or virtual line. Only applied when the call `routingType` is `SKILL_BASED`.

joinEnabled.description: Indicates the join status of the agent for this queue. The default value while creating call queue is `true`.
